title: Three Minutes of Quiet
summary: Every hour a siren sounds across the city, and a woman has three minutes to cross the skybridge before the infected come back.

beats.text: Every hour, a siren sounds. Then the city goes quiet for three minutes.
The infected run toward the noise. The lobby empties.
I need those minutes. The bridge to the car park is four hundred steps.
I set a timer. Two minutes fifty-seven, fifty-six.
I walked with my shoes in my hand. Glass bridges carry sound.
Halfway across, the siren did not sound. The hour passed. Nothing.
Every infected below turned and looked up. They knew the siren was late.
A message arrived from a number I did not know. Run. Sorry. I fell asleep.
Someone else had been ringing that siren for nine days. Keeping me alive.
I ran the last steps. Far behind me, the siren began. It sounded like an apology.
